name: comp-261

frames.best_why: The knob is raised to a higher step with a focus halo, showing the upright track and its white fill clearly.

tagline: Drag a round knob up and down a short upright track.
summary: A single-value slider turned on its side, standing vertically under a small centred label. The track fills white beneath the knob as the value climbs.
appearance: A small grey label is centred at the top. Below it a narrow vertical grey track runs down the middle, with a solid white lower section and a round white knob resting partway up.
behaviour: Dragging the knob up or down moves it in ten even steps, and the white fill follows beneath it. The knob carries a soft ring while it is being held.
demo_content: The label simply reads "Vertical slider"; the knob starts near the middle of a 0 to 10 scale.
search_phrases: vertical bar to pick a level
single knob on an upright track
tall narrow slider for one value
drag a knob toward the top
level control in a side panel
use_when: A single level or height should sit in a tall narrow slot beside a tool or preview.
avoid_when: No number or scale is shown, so the exact value is hard to read.
customise: The label text and maximum value are in the source, along with the fixed height; the orientation is not switchable by a prop here.
weight_why: One vertical track and a knob; nothing moves when untouched.

a11y.note: It is named for assistive tech and accepts arrow keys, but no readout tells anyone the current value.

issues: The chosen value never appears on screen, so only the knob's height conveys it.
polish_why: Clean and quiet, but a bare upright track with no scale or readout.
title: Vertical Slider
